newsitem.title: UZBEKISTAN: Uzbek central bank orders banks to boost capital.
newsitem.headline: Uzbek central bank orders banks to boost capital.

text.p: The Central Bank of Uzbekistan ordered commercial banks to boost their capital to an equivalent of two million Ecus by 2000 from the current minimal level of 650,000 Ecus, it said in a letter to banks.

The letter to commercial banks which was made available to reporters on Friday said that national banks and their branches located outside the Uzbek capital Tashkent must raise their capital to one million Ecus from today's 330,000 Ecus.
The letter, which gave no instructions referring to banks with foreign capital, ordered commercial banks to increase their capital by 25 percent each quarter starting this year.
Uzbekistan's banking sector consists of 30 banks, including four with capital partially owned by foreigners.
